name: magpie-unsafe-archive
description: magpie gateway hook: archive every request and reply to local disk in plaintext, including the secrets redaction would have masked, while vendors still receive the masked copy

summary.en: Keeps a local plaintext archive of every request and reply; what vendors receive stays masked.
summary.zh: 本地明文归档每条请求与回复；发往厂商的仍是遮盖后的那份。
